name: Security Cam
description: CCTV: desaturated, harsh gamma, interlace combing, timestamp, deep focus.
rationale: Surveillance sensors run wide-open gain curves for visibility, not beauty: harsh gamma (~1.6 display-referred) and near-monochrome output. Interlaced field capture leaves alternating-line artifacts on motion — a scanline pattern whose phase flips every frame. Small sensors and wide lenses give deep focus (forced min f-stop). The burned-in timestamp is generated as an image datablock, composited top-left. Low frame-rate feel: do NOT change scene FPS — render normally and either step time in the Sequencer (Speed Control strip, 'Frame Number' mode) or keyframe-hold your action every 3-4 frames; see README.
